cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and the full effect of A Grave Inheritance. The per-opponent iteration and the conditional 'evict 2 voters belonging to every player who FAILS TO PAY' are not expressible in the Effect union â€” see KNOWN-GAPS.md G2. `text` therefore describes only what `effects` does.
cards.name: A Grave Inheritance
cards.text: Take 2 resources of your choice from a chosen opponent. Then evict 2 voters from the board.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and effect of Eradicating Germs. DROPPED: the mandatory RECURRING obligation ('Discard an open Voter Card every turn' â€” a per-turn duty on a player, needs PlayerState.obligations, KNOWN-GAPS G3) and the denomination ('any 1 resource denoted on it', which needs the discarded card's cost surfaced as a Choice, G17). An earlier revision said 'gain 1 resource, discard 1 resource', which is not this card; the single resolution is the market refresh plus the resource.
cards.name: Eradicating Germs
cards.text: Every face-up Voter Card is discarded and replaced with a fresh one. You then gain 1 resource of your choice.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and the first branch of Singularity ('Get 2 voters'). The second branch ('Collect and use 3 Singularity cards to permanently unlock any Level 5 Ideologue Power', 4 copies in the deck) is a set-collection op that does not exist â€” see KNOWN-GAPS.md G6.
cards.name: Singularity
cards.text: Gain 2 voters. They are not from a Voter Card, so you may place them in different zones.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and the first branch of The Psychohistorian ('Get 1 voter (not card) and any 2 resources'). The second branch is a hidden three-action combo detector ('Trade resources with an opponent. Break one of their majorities. Play another Conspiracy Card on them') which needs a set-combo op and a secrecy flag â€” see KNOWN-GAPS.md G7.
cards.name: The Psychohistorian
cards.text: Gain 1 voter and 2 resources of your choice. The voter is not from a Voter Card.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.1 (the name puns on the mechanic) and REF 8.2.
cards.name: Confidential Annex
cards.text: Gain 2 Funds and 1 Trust from the Public Reserve. Then get 2 discounts on purchases this turn.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2. The steal-then-voter shape is the same archetype as the recovered A Grave Inheritance (REF 4.2.1) with the conditional clause removed.
cards.name: Quiet Redrafting
cards.text: Take 1 resource of your choice from a chosen opponent. Then gain 1 voter.

cards.name: The Wet Season Argument
cards.text: Evict 2 voters from the board. Then gain 1 resource of your choice.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2. refresh-market is the only op in the union with no payload; the market is never allowed below RULES.marketSize, so dealing three is always legal (RULES p10).
cards.name: Filed Under Normal
cards.text: Get 1 discount on a purchase this turn. Then discard every face-up Voter Card and deal three fresh ones.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 recovers POWER TRIP. The trigger is PERFORMED (G14): on-voter-influenced with influencedVotersAtLeast 3 IS 'every time you influence a 3-Voter Card', byOwner IS 'you', and no movedMyVoter is needed because the printed discard is the card's own action rather than a theft. DROPPED, named: 'non-majority' (the engine reaches any peg an opponent owns, which is WIDER) and the printed 'you can' (the hook fires, so the discard is MANDATORY). Each opponent chooses which of their own. Refires the inferred DRY DOCK.
cards.name: Power Trip
cards.text: For the rest of the game, every time YOU influence a Voter Card carrying 3 or more voters, each opponent must strike 1 of their own voters from the board permanently — including a majority. Voters in Volatile Areas cannot be struck.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 recovers If You Like Pina Colada: 'Double all the resources on your player mat. Your current resource cap still applies.' G4 + G15 landed for exactly this shape: a res of 1 in EACH resource times held-of-each-resource IS a doubling of the mat, and the cap is enforced by the same gain path, which is the card's own second sentence. Still `adapted`, not `verbatim`, only because the recovered text carries an accent the deck's title casing does not. Refires the inferred THE LONG COMMUTE.
cards.name: If You Like Pina Colada
cards.text: Double every resource on your Mat: you gain one extra Funds, one extra Clout, one extra Media and one extra Trust for each one you are already holding. Your resource cap still applies, so a Mat already at the cap cannot be doubled.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2. Budget Hai Patra Nahi archetype (ct-in2020-003) reskinned: the card spends as much as it takes, so the resource count nets to zero against a cap of 12.
cards.name: Load Shedding, Properly Explained
cards.text: Pay 2 Funds to the Public Reserve to keep the district dark for one night, then take 2 resources of your choice from it.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 recovers SELECTIVE ACCESS MEMORY. G17 is HALF closed and the half that shipped is the deal: draw-conspiracy carries from: 'discard', and a Conspiracy Card discard pile is honest to read because such a card is bought and held and never answered face up. DROPPED, named, and it is the card's whole point: 'pick ANY ... in any order' is a 'choose-card' decision, REFUSED AT THE TYPE LEVEL because rendering it means listing the pile, and the piles are _-prefixed and stripped by playerView, so the OPTION LIST would be the leak. Refires the inferred SERVER SPACE.
cards.name: Selective Access Memory
cards.text: Take the top Conspiracy Card from the discard pile into your hand. The printed card lets you pick ANY card from that pile in ANY order; only the top of it is reachable here.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788) recovers Holo Sapiens. SHIPS ON ITS FIRST SENTENCE ALONE - 'This is an extra Ideology Card' - put to you at your next turn. Same template as Jumla per REF 4.2.2, so the identical reduction to ct-in2020-011 and the identical omissions: G17, G15's price field, G23, and G12 for expiry-on-purchase. Not counted twice as an archetype. Argument in KNOWN-GAPS.md G20.
cards.name: Holo Sapiens
cards.text: This is an extra Ideology Card. You will be put it at the start of your next turn, face down, and you will not be told which one.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 recovers BLOCK. SHIPS THE REACTIVE HALF, which G13 executes: out of turn it negates the staged resolution; one answer per window, so it cannot be reversed or deflected. 'Actions not aimed at you may also be blocked' is why target:any-card. DROPPED: 'Discard an open Conspiracy Card or Headline Card' (no op discards an open card); 'block a card stealing this card' (G20 moves Ideology Cards only); 'cleanse an already-active card' (no op removes a LiveEffect, G9/G22). WIDENED: a window also opens on a Headline resolving. 'Otherwise: gain 1 Clout' AUTHORED. G13d.
cards.name: Block
cards.text: Play this IMMEDIATELY out of turn when an opponent plays a Conspiracy Card, or a Headline resolves, to negate that card's effect entirely. It cannot be reversed or deflected, and a card not aimed at you may also be blocked. Otherwise: gain 1 Clout.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 recovers DEFLECT. SHIPS THE REACTIVE HALF (G13): out of turn it retargets the staged resolution onto any player who is neither actor nor responder. DEVIATIONS: 'only that partial effect is deflected' DROPPED - one target per effect list, so the WHOLE resolution is redirected (G20); the text says 'whole effect'. 'Affects you' WIDENED to target:any-card, because card-affecting-you resolves via reachesPastActor, which asks whether an effect aims past its OWNER (G1). 'It cannot be blocked' is not recovered but true. 'Otherwise: gain 1 Trust' AUTHORED. G13d.
cards.name: Deflect
cards.text: Play this IMMEDIATELY out of turn when an opponent plays a card, to redirect that card's whole effect onto a third player of your choosing - whoever it was aimed at. It cannot be blocked. Otherwise: gain 1 Trust.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 recovers Cut, Copy, and Paste: 'select 1 of your majorities. Discard all your voters in that zone. If any empty area is left at the start of your next turn, convert all its voters into yours'. G16 landed for the SELECTOR: `zone: chosen-zone` raises a decision, and only when a constituency holds a voter the effect could name, so nobody is frozen by one. DROPPED, named: the second turn (G22); '1 of your MAJORITIES' (the selector offers any constituency holding a voter of yours, the one clause this card is WIDER on); 'all your voters' as a count. G16.
cards.name: Cut, Copy, and Paste
cards.text: Select one constituency. Discard 2 of your voters from it -- they leave the board permanently, and voters in Volatile Areas cannot be discarded.
